editorial:
Imagine you are part of a comedy crew that has totally hit rock bottom. You are playing to empty rooms and your jokes are not landing anymore. That is exactly where the characters start in this wild ride. You get to follow these desperate performers as they accidentally stumble into a situation where they have to commit actual crimes to get famous. It starts as a funny look at how far people will go for a break, but it quickly turns into a scary game of survival. The vibe is a mix of a late-night stand-up set and a nightmare, making you laugh one second and jump in your seat the next.

You will love how the actors handle the shift from goofy to terrified. The pacing is great and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some of the gore might be too much for some, the humor balances it out perfectly. If you love dark comedies, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a smart move.
endingExplained: The big twist happens when you realize the talent agent was actually a serial killer using the group for his own games. In the final scene, the last surviving comedian uses a prop from their act to trick the agent into a trap. They end up killing him in a way that looks like a comedy sketch. The movie ends with the survivor becoming a huge star by telling the true story as a joke.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and surprise twists.
